AVAILABILITY

Injuries and depth deficiencies

The official injury report joined to the official game books, so every unavailable starter is mapped to the specific replacement who must take the slot.

How depth is measured

The injury report says who is unavailable. The official game book says who played: it lists the starting eleven for both teams, the substitution list, the did-not-play list and the inactive list. Joining the two gives the replacement who must take the slot, and therefore which string of the depth chart absorbs the absence. A 1st string replaced by the 2nd string is a depth deficit of 1; a 4th string absorbing it is a deficit of 3. Nothing about how much production is lost is claimed here - that is an estimate, and it is listed as an open item.
